snippet.title: My Name Is Crocodilо - Game SoundTrack (CROCOCO)
snippet.description:
The song from the game that everyone ended up loving.

Many players asked where they could listen to it separately, so here it is  now available on the channel.

Enjoy "My Name Is Crocodile" by Drunk Proctologists, straight from CROCOCO. 

If you've played the game, thank you for your support. And if you haven't yet... maybe it's time to meet the crocodile.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4699110/Crococo
